title: YOUVA EdAI Cross-Jurisdiction Institutional Compliance Matrix

controls.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.implementation: Strict fail-closed RBAC with Student, Teacher, Parent, Admin personas

controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.implementation: Mandatory MFA for all administrative and institutional staff accounts

controls.name: Encryption in Transit
controls.implementation: TLS 1.3 enforced across all public and internal endpoints with HSTS

controls.name: Encryption at Rest
controls.implementation: AES-256 with tenant-scoped encryption keys and envelope encryption

controls.name: Tamper-Evident Hash-Chained Audit Ledger
controls.implementation: Cryptographic SHA-256 HMAC hash chaining for all consent, learning, and credential events

controls.name: Verifiable Parental Consent (VPC)
controls.implementation: Fail-closed VPC gate prior to any student profile activation under jurisdiction threshold

controls.name: Right to Erasure / Consent Withdrawal
controls.implementation: Immediate session invalidation and verifiable cryptographic purge within jurisdiction SLA

controls.name: Prohibition on Behavioral Tracking & Targeted Advertising
controls.implementation: Zero third-party trackers, zero advertising SDKs, zero behavioral profiling for commercial use

controls.name: Human-Authorization Invariant for Consequential Decisions
controls.implementation: AI models generate recommendations only; credentialing and grade decisions require verified human teacher signature

controls.name: Automated Safety Drift Circuit Breaker
controls.implementation: Continuous evaluation with automatic fail-closed rollback if safety/accuracy drift exceeds 5%
